open.EP.title: Folded to you in an early seat
open.EP.reason: Placeholder: early seats act first, so only strong hands open.

open.LJ.title: Folded to you in the lojack

ranges.raise: 66+, A9s+, KTs+, QTs+, JTs, AJo+, KQo

open.LJ.reason: Placeholder: a few more hands open from the lojack.

open.HJ.title: Folded to you in the hijack

ranges.raise: 55+, A7s+, A5s, K9s+, Q9s+, J9s+, T9s, 98s, ATo+, KJo+

open.CO.title: Folded to you in the cutoff

ranges.raise: 44+, A2s+, K8s+, Q9s+, J9s+, T9s, 98s, 87s, A9o+, KTo+, QJo

open.CO.reason: Placeholder: only the button and the blinds are left to act.

open.BTN.title: Folded to you on the button
open.BTN.reason: Placeholder: the button acts last after the flop, so it opens the most hands.

open.SB.title: Small blind, folded to you

ranges.raise: 33+, A2s+, K7s+, Q9s+, J9s+, T9s, 98s, 87s, A8o+, KTo+, QJo

open.SB.reason: Placeholder: only the big blind is left to beat, but you act first after the flop.

limpers.early.title: Facing limpers from an early or middle seat
limpers.early.reason: Placeholder: limpers make the pot bigger, so raise your strong hands.

limpers.late.title: Facing limpers from the cutoff or button

ranges.raise: 77+, A9s+, KTs+, QTs+, JTs, T9s, 98s, ATo+, KQo

limpers.late.reason: Placeholder: in late seats you can raise more hands over limpers.

limpers.SB.title: Small blind facing limpers

ranges.call: 22-99, A2s-ATs, K9s-KJs, QTs+, JTs, T9s, 98s, 87s, ATo-AJo, KQo, KJo

limpers.SB.reason: Placeholder: you already have a blind in, so some hands can just call.

limpers.BB.title: Big blind facing limpers
limpers.BB.reason: Placeholder: you can see the flop for free, so raise only your best hands.

raise.vsEarly.title: Facing a raise from an early seat
raise.vsEarly.reason: Placeholder: an early raiser has a strong hand, so you need one too.

raise.vsLate.title: Facing a raise from a late seat

ranges.call: 66-99, ATs-AJs, KQs, QJs, JTs, T9s, AQo

raise.vsLate.reason: Placeholder: a late raiser opens many hands, so you can play more of yours.
